ModsRoot: <path to your Reloaded-II Mods folder, e.g. C:\Users\you\Reloaded-II\Mods>
OutRoot: <where converted mods should be written, e.g. C:\p5r-mergeable-output>
EnCpkPath: <path to EN.CPK (or your locale's CPK), e.g. D:\...\CPK\EN.CPK>
PakPackExe: <path to PAKPack.exe (only needed for PAK-nested BMD conversion)>
TempRoot: <a scratch directory for temporary decompile output, e.g. C:\p5r-convert-tmp>
